5秒视频，赛博朋克油污风唱跳女团MV：四名东亚女生在工业仓库边唱边跳，舞姿性感但不夸张快速、幅度小；大字为演唱词。运镜用手持跟随、低角度仰拍、横移与半环绕，景别跳级，硬切卡鼓点；暗调霓虹、重低音电子乐,不要全景。

integrated_multimodal_description:  
5-second vertical cyberpunk oil-stained girl-group music video, developed from Image 1. Preserve the lead performer’s identity, facial features, long black hair, black tailored suit, beige headset microphone, elegant makeup, and confident direct gaze. She performs in a dark industrial warehouse with four East Asian female performers total, all wearing coordinated black performance outfits with subtle glossy, oil-stained textures and restrained metallic cyberpunk details. The four women sing and dance together with fast, small-amplitude, controlled movements: sharp hand gestures, compact shoulder hits, precise hip accents, synchronized steps, and confident expressions; sexy and charismatic but never exaggerated or vulgar.

[0.0–0.8s] Start in a tight close-up matching Image 1: the lead singer faces the camera, headset microphone visible near her cheek, one hand raised beside her face in a precise finger gesture. Black warehouse background, out-of-focus blue, amber, and white practical lights, oily reflections and faint haze. A subtle handheld push-in begins on the first beat. Large bold Chinese lyric text appears across the lower-middle area, clean high-contrast typography, synchronized to the vocal.

[0.8–1.7s] Hard cut exactly on the beat to a low-angle medium close-up of the lead singer with two other women entering behind her in staggered depth. The camera tilts slightly upward and tracks backward handheld as they perform compact synchronized arm and shoulder choreography. Neon cyan and dirty amber rim lights trace their silhouettes; black metal beams, stained concrete, pipes, and wet reflective floor remain visible behind them. Large Chinese lyric text changes on the beat without obscuring faces.

[1.7–2.6s] Hard cut to a lateral handheld tracking shot moving from left to right across all four performers in a tight medium shot, never widening to a full shot. They sing toward camera while executing quick, minimal side steps and sharply timed hand shapes. The lead remains the visual anchor near center frame, while the other three briefly pass through foreground and background layers. Add oily lens flares, blue-magenta neon reflections, drifting warehouse haze, and strong contrast.

[2.6–3.6s] Hard cut to a low-angle close medium shot. The four performers lean and rebound in a compact synchronized move, then turn their faces toward the lens on the downbeat. The camera makes a fast half-orbit around the lead from front-left to front-right, with slight handheld instability and shallow depth of field. Their black outfits catch thin wet-looking highlights; the industrial walls and pipes smear into dark neon bokeh. Large bold Chinese lyric text pulses or changes exactly with the beat.

[3.6–4.4s] Hard cut to a compressed, tight group composition with the lead in front and the other three diagonally behind her. They perform small rapid hand choreography near chest and face level, maintaining controlled sensuality and strong eye contact. The camera slides horizontally while slightly panning upward, creating layered parallax between performers, hanging cables, metal scaffolding, and colored lights. No wide establishing shot.

[4.4–5.0s] Hard cut on the final beat to an extreme close-up of the lead singer. She finishes the lyric with a confident half-smile and a small finger gesture toward the lens; the headset microphone and facial details remain sharp. Blue and orange industrial lights flicker softly in the dark background. End on a crisp held pose for a fraction of a second, with the final large Chinese lyric text locked near the lower-middle frame. Maintain consistent faces, body proportions, hair, costumes, lighting logic, and four-person continuity throughout. Fast rhythmic editing, hard cuts aligned to drum hits, no full shot, no empty frame, no excessive dancing, no exaggerated body motion, no deformed hands, no extra limbs, no facial identity drift.

overall_soundscape:  
Dark industrial warehouse ambience blended with heavy sub-bass electronic music: deep controlled bass pressure, punchy kick, tight electronic snare, crisp hi-hats, distorted synth pulses, metallic impact hits, faint machinery hum, distant ventilation, subtle chain and pipe resonances, and short reverse risers before each hard cut. The performers’ vocal performance is clear and rhythmic, with the lead vocal forward in the mix and restrained group backing vocals. Every camera cut, hand hit, shoulder accent, lyric change, and final pose aligns precisely with the beat. No dialogue, no crowd noise, no natural outdoor ambience.

non_diegetic_music:  
A 5-second dark cyberpunk electronic girl-group track at approximately 128 BPM, dominated by deep sub-bass, punchy kick drums, clipped industrial percussion, distorted bass synth, metallic glitch textures, and sharp cyan-magenta arpeggiated stabs. Begin immediately with a strong downbeat, use compact four-on-the-floor momentum, add a brief rising electronic accent before the half-orbit, and finish with a hard bass hit and short reverberant tail at 5.0 seconds. The vocal melody should feel assertive, sleek, and performance-driven. Use large bold Chinese lyric text synchronized to the sung words; do not invent small subtitles or unrelated text.
